title: SF631 (2023-2024 Regular): Information collected and scope of background check conducted for noncitizen permit to carry applicants expansion

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-20; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/631/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: the introduced bill as filed (2023-01-20); no passage vote recorded, no later amendments. The IAQ sentence in Section 2 prints without a strike mark; the text read does not show underlining, so it is not confirmed as new wording. Check is part of the permit background check, not a deportation step.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (7) if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the applicant's country of birth and alien number or alien admission number.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 4): In addition, if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the sheriff must ensure that an Immigration Alien Query (IAQ) check is performed on the applicant.
